## Summary
- **Overall posture:** The architecture follows standard multi-AZ patterns for compute, load balancing, and database layers, but requires hardening across security controls, data persistence policies, and cost-efficiency mechanisms.

- **Quickest win:** Enable server-side encryption, block public access on the S3 upload bucket, and configure AWS Compute Optimizer and Trusted Advisor to instantly surface cost and sizing improvements.

## Answer
The 5 genres with the most tracks are Rock (1,297 tracks), Latin (579 tracks), Metal (374 tracks), Alternative & Punk (332 tracks), and Jazz (130 tracks).

## Data
| Genre | TrackCount |
|---|---|
| Rock | 1297 |
| Latin | 579 |
| Metal | 374 |
| Alternative & Punk | 332 |
| Jazz | 130 |

## SQL used
```sql
SELECT g.Name AS Genre, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM Genre g
JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

## Notes
- Results are ordered by track count in descending order, limited to the top 5 genres.
